purpose: Bind approved masters, copy, covers, captions, ledgers and delivery settings into one artifact.
hard_gates: Every package component must match its approved hash and public publishing must remain disabled.
soft_gates: Platform copy, cover and metadata should adapt the same approved story without generic filler.

failure.fallback: Keep the complete local package and retry private delivery without rebuilding upstream work.

regression_cases: A post-engine edit must be re-imported before analytics can attach.
